thematic_groups.name: 주인에 대한 인상과 그 근거
thematic_groups.logic: relation opening first; attach compatible danger/strictness reasoning. Fear emotion is not identical to consequence awareness.
thematic_groups.do_not: Do not turn knowing consequences into fear, or lack of fear into trust.

thematic_groups.name: 명령에 대한 태도와 따르는 이유
thematic_groups.logic: willingness boundary then practical/rational reason. Use contrast when unwilling obedience and reward advantage coexist.
thematic_groups.do_not: Do not infer voluntary loyalty from pragmatic reward acceptance.

thematic_groups.name: 권위와 소유 관계에 대한 이해
thematic_groups.logic: felt authority and learned ownership/life dependence are distinct axes. Link by cause only when words actually support it; otherwise explicit contrast or separate page.
thematic_groups.do_not: Do not relabel awe/pressure as consent or gratitude.

thematic_groups.name: 감사와 헌신의 결론
thematic_groups.logic: close with actual gratitude/devotion/absence of devotion. Relation_servile/obedient and high moral may repeat; combine same conclusion once without inventing extra feeling.
thematic_groups.do_not: Do not turn moral_0 into gratitude or drop factual emotional disagreements.

page_policy.unit: Keep complete core + qualified detail together
page_policy.target: Combine 2 compatible meaning units per page, not a strict array-position pair
page_policy.overflow: If full units do not fit, break between complete meaning units; never split a sentence
page_policy.cues: At most one action cue per combined response page
page_policy.events: Existing A/B/C/D stay eligible only under original recent/today guards and relationship constraints; do not add automatic praise after hostile lines
page_policy.preserve: Do not shorten by randomly omitting selected facts; remove only semantically duplicate expressions when composed meaning is preserved
